label: Kevin's Ramen & Boba (portfolio demos/room)

capture.note: Honor quality preset capture.dpr. Photosphere: detach OrbitControls (enabled=false, no update), no vignette on cube faces, reject-black before save.

photosphere.label: ramen-hq
photosphere.note: Plaza eye in front of kiosk; look −Z for storefront. Face size from preset photosphere.size (social 1024 / print 2048 / archive 3072). Host: OrbitControls detached, post off, Node bilinear stitch.

4d.note: Default showcase: fixed-eye live (--orbit live --frames 32 --settle-ms ≥600 --fps 8) so steam/lights animate; encode ≥4s loop (32/8=4.0s) + mux ambient audio. --orbit yaw only when explicit (never default showcase).

scripts.syncDemo: node -e "console.log('From 4dps package: npm run demo (syncs ramen-hq then ramen-demo into demo/assets)')"

validation.note: Run checkHq / check4dFrames / check4dMp4 / check4dAudio FROM 4dps package root (npm run check:hq lives here), with PORTFOLIO_ROOM=absolute host demos/room. Host room has no check:hq script. scripts.4dAudio is host ffmpeg mux (cwd=projectRoot) using public/audio/night-market.mp3 after encode. scripts.drone documents host harness path capture + 7dps encode-drone. minMadLive=1e-4 fails MAD≈0 still packs only — NOT user-visible steam proof (H6 needs visual steam + ≥~4s). minMadYaw=0.02 is turntable-scale; never use as live gate. Do not use plaza-photosphere as demo fallback. H6 is NOT green from adapter text alone.

notes: Hard host path: set PORTFOLIO_ROOM to absolute demos/room (default /workspace/portfolio/demos/room). Relative ../../../portfolio/... is wrong if resolved from other cwds — always prefer PORTFOLIO_ROOM. If projectRoot missing, loadAdapter hard-fails (do not silent-fixture). Showcase: --quality social (default) or print. Host: live 4D 32@8fps settle≥600 face 1024; mux night-market.mp3; then 7dps grid/encode/view. Demo defaultYaw 180deg toward kiosk.
